note: Per-platform toolchain pins for the VodBox rebuild. Flags are derived from the retained upstream build scripts (dependency-sources/upstream-evidence/native-provenance/release-inputs/backend/unicorn2/src/main/native/*_build.sh) but the concrete numbers VodBox selects are recorded here so nothing is inherited silently.

static_engine_archive.produced_by: pinned engine CMakeLists.txt: add_library(unicorn ...) with BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF (CMake archive)
static_engine_archive.naming: Linux/Darwin: libunicorn.a ; MinGW (drops lib prefix): unicorn.a
static_engine_archive.location: CMake output dir <engine>/build/. This matches the retained upstream scripts, which link $UNICORN_HOME/build/libunicorn.a.
static_engine_archive.verified_against: dependency-sources/archives/unicorn-548eda466eb9a2c69723a0f74888aa7b889b4ed9.tar.gz CMakeLists.txt (line 1175 add_library(unicorn), line 61 UNICORN_ARCH) and the retained upstream *_build.sh link lines ($UNICORN_HOME/build/libunicorn.a)
static_engine_archive.build_system_correction: The pinned engine is the Unicorn2 line and is CMake-ONLY (no make.sh/Makefile). Earlier notes describing a Makefile with UNICORN_STATIC=yes/LIBNAME=unicorn and 'no build/ subdir' were read from the retained Unicorn1 *_build.sh header comment and do NOT apply to this tree.
static_engine_archive.used_by: build-backend.sh engine_static() picks whichever of the two names exists under <engine>/build/

output_library_name.source_of_truth: com.github.unidbg.arm.backend.Unicorn2Factory calls NativeLoader.loadLibrary("unicorn") in the pinned unidbg-unicorn2:0.9.8 sources jar; the native entry points are Java_com_github_unidbg_arm_backend_unicorn_Unicorn_*

linux-x64.compiler: gcc (system; pin exact version at build time)

linux-arm64.source_reference: linux_build.sh (target arch via engine UNICORN_ARCHS + toolchain)

osx-x64.note: Upstream osx_build.sh is -m64 without -arch; confirm host arch and add explicit -arch x86_64 to avoid an arm64 default on Apple Silicon.

win-x64.engine_archive: unicorn.a (MinGW AR naming) in the engine source root; upstream windows_build.sh links exactly this

jni_headers.generated_by: NOT regenerated by default. The four com_github_unidbg_arm_backend_unicorn_Unicorn{,_NewHook,_UnHook,_Tuple}.h are retained in release-inputs/.../native/ and consumed directly by unicorn.h.
jni_headers.regeneration_if_needed: javac -h (javah was removed in JDK 10+); requires com/github/unidbg/arm/backend/unicorn/Unicorn.class on the classpath
jni_headers.jdk_pin: JDK 17+ (upstream used 1.8 javah; the JNI header content is ABI-stable, so the retained headers are used as-is). Record the exact JDK at build time.
